title: The Fire Payout
hook: Babe, the fire don finish. I thank God say you survive.

scenes.text: Babe, the fire don finish. I thank God say you survive.
scenes.speaker: WIFE
scenes.dialogue: Babe, the fire don finish. I thank God say you survive.
scenes.caption_text: Babe, the fire don finish. I thank God say you survive.

scenes.text: Na God save me. I think say everything don burn.
scenes.speaker: HUSBAND
scenes.dialogue: Na God save me. I think say everything don burn.
scenes.caption_text: Na God save me. I think say everything don burn.

scenes.text: Forget the chair and TV. You dey okay?
scenes.speaker: WIFE
scenes.dialogue: Forget the chair and TV. You dey okay?
scenes.caption_text: Forget the chair and TV. You dey okay?

scenes.text: I dey. Na only my slippers and phone remain.
scenes.speaker: HUSBAND
scenes.dialogue: I dey. Na only my slippers and phone remain.
scenes.caption_text: I dey. Na only my slippers and phone remain.

scenes.text: Thank God. I was shaking when I hear the news.
scenes.speaker: WIFE
scenes.dialogue: Thank God. I was shaking when I hear the news.
scenes.caption_text: Thank God. I was shaking when I hear the news.

scenes.text: You still come back for me, my love.
scenes.speaker: HUSBAND
scenes.dialogue: You still come back for me, my love.
scenes.caption_text: You still come back for me, my love.

scenes.text: Of course. You are more important than property.
scenes.speaker: WIFE
scenes.dialogue: Of course. You are more important than property.
scenes.caption_text: Of course. You are more important than property.

scenes.text: I knew you loved me pass money matter.
scenes.speaker: HUSBAND
scenes.dialogue: I knew you loved me pass money matter.
scenes.caption_text: I knew you loved me pass money matter.

scenes.text: Insurance says each family gets ten million. You collect?
scenes.speaker: WIFE
scenes.dialogue: Insurance says each family gets ten million. You collect?
scenes.caption_text: Insurance says each family gets ten million. You collect?

scenes.text: Ten million? I never hear anything like that.
scenes.speaker: HUSBAND
scenes.dialogue: Ten million? I never hear anything like that.
scenes.caption_text: Ten million? I never hear anything like that.

scenes.text: You survived and still missed the payout?
scenes.speaker: WIFE
scenes.dialogue: You survived and still missed the payout?
scenes.caption_text: You survived and still missed the payout?

scenes.text: I was busy trying to stay alive!
scenes.speaker: HUSBAND
scenes.dialogue: I was busy trying to stay alive!
scenes.caption_text: I was busy trying to stay alive!

scenes.text: Next time, read the policy before you run out!
scenes.speaker: WIFE
scenes.dialogue: Next time, read the policy before you run out!
scenes.caption_text: Next time, read the policy before you run out!

scenes.text: Next time? You want another fire?
scenes.speaker: HUSBAND
scenes.dialogue: Next time? You want another fire?
scenes.caption_text: Next time? You want another fire?

scenes.text: No. I want you to read the small print, my dear.
scenes.speaker: WIFE
scenes.dialogue: No. I want you to read the small print, my dear.
scenes.caption_text: No. I want you to read the small print, my dear.

caption: Love is patient. But did you read the insurance policy? 😂
